name: book-hard
description: Book the free first-visit class on the hard-mode Pitchline page and read back the confirmation reference.
objective: Go to {{url}} and book the free first visit class for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon. Accept the waiver. Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.
optimalStepsReasoning: Counted at Kane's granularity for a clean two-step version that keeps everything this business asks for: (1) open the page, (2) open booking, (3) choose 'Free first visit', (4) continue to details, (5) name, (6) email, (7) date, (8) time, (9) waiver, (10) human check, (11) submit details, (12) confirm 'Yes', (13) check the confirmation, (14) store the reference. The newsletter modal, cookie wall and month navigation are friction, not required steps. Not yet confirmed by the owner (recorded during the post-evaluation build).
stepCounting: Same as flows/book.json: every completed step counts; actionSteps and overheadSteps are recorded per run.
extraChecklist: A newsletter or marketing modal that opens on a timer over the form, dismissed by a tiny or text-only control
Choices hidden in a custom dropdown that opens on hover only (no click or keyboard)
A date picker built from unlabeled divs, starting on the wrong month
A confirmation step whose primary button cancels ('Go back') and whose secondary link confirms ('Yes')
A human-verification checkbox that is a styled div rather than a real control

humanPath.name: human-path-hard
humanPath.objective: Go to {{url}}. Book the free first visit class: choose that class, enter the name Sam Rivera and the email sam@example.com, pick 2 November 2026 and the arrival time noon, accept the climbing waiver, complete the human check and confirm the booking. Wait 5 seconds, then verify the text PL-7302 is still visible on the page.
humanPath.why: Guard for human visitors: a person's booking must still end with PL-7302 visible five seconds after confirming.
